description_en: Queries information about the cloud computers whose images can be and are pending to be updated to the specified version
description_zh: 获取可升级到指定版本镜像但尚未升级的云电脑信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-fota-pending-desktops --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --task-uid aot-c4khwrp9ocml40000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeFotaPendingDesktops

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100.
Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，每页最大行数。

最大值：100
默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of `NextToken`
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的`NextToken`参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the image update task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/437001.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 镜像升级任务的信息。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/437001.html获取该参数
parameters.name: task_uid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud computer
parameters.name: desktop_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the office network. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/216071.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 办公网络ID。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/216071.html获取该参数
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the cloud computer
parameters.name: desktop_name

FotaPendingDesktops.description_en: The cloud computers whose images can be and are pending to be updated to the version specified in `TaskUid`
FotaPendingDesktops.description_zh: 可升级到`TaskUid`对应版本的镜像但尚未升级的云电脑列表

items.description_zh: 可升级到`TaskUid`对应版本的镜像但尚未升级的云电脑

CurrentAppVersion.description_en: The current version of the image used by the cloud computer
CurrentAppVersion.description_zh: 云电脑当前的镜像版本

DesktopId.description_en: The ID of the cloud computer

DesktopName.description_en: The name of the cloud computer

FotaProject.description_en: This parameter is not publicly available
FotaProject.description_zh: 此参数不对外开放使用

OfficeSiteId.description_en: The ID of the office network

EndUserId.description_en: The ID of the end user that connects to the cloud computer

Status.description_en:
The status of the cloud computer.

Valid values:

0: The cloud computer is being created.
1: The cloud computer is being started.
2: The cloud computer is running.
3: The cloud computer is being stopped.
5: The cloud computer is stopped.
6: The cloud computer expires.
7: The cloud computer is deleted.
9: Failed to create the cloud computer

NextToken.description_en: A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If NextToken is empty, no next page exists
NextToken.description_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个
